description: Music and soundscape metadata for Calm Quest — ambient tracks for relaxation and focus

tracks.title: Morning Dew
tracks.description: Gentle forest sounds with soft birdsong and the delicate rustle of leaves in a light breeze. Recorded in a temperate woodland at dawn.

tracks.title: Ocean Horizon
tracks.description: Steady, rhythmic waves rolling onto a sandy shore. The distant cry of seagulls and the soft whisper of sea foam create an endless sense of calm.

tracks.title: Rainy Window
tracks.description: A steady, gentle rainfall against glass, with occasional distant thunder rumbles. The perfect backdrop for introspection or sleep.

tracks.title: Mountain Stream
tracks.description: Crystal-clear water flowing over smooth stones in a high-altitude stream. The crisp, clean sound of moving water at a consistent, calming pace.

tracks.title: Summer Meadow
tracks.description: A warm field alive with gentle wind, buzzing insects, and the occasional bird call. Evokes lazy afternoons and open skies.

tracks.title: Starlit Silence
tracks.description: Deep, atmospheric pads with subtle shimmering textures that evoke the vastness of a star-filled night sky. Minimalist and deeply peaceful.

tracks.title: Drifting Nebula
tracks.description: Slow-evolving ambient tones that shift subtly like cosmic clouds. Ethereal textures float and merge, inviting deep relaxation.

tracks.title: Temple Bells
tracks.description: Soft, resonant singing bowls and distant temple bells recorded in a quiet meditation space. Each tone lingers and fades into silence.

tracks.title: Deep Space
tracks.description: Low, rumbling sub-bass tones layered with high-frequency shimmer. Creates a sensation of floating in the vast emptiness of space.

tracks.title: Warm Blanket
tracks.description: Soft, enveloping ambient textures with gentle harmonic shifts. Like being wrapped in warmth and safety — perfect for anxiety relief.

tracks.title: Alpha Waves (10 Hz)
tracks.description: Pure binaural beat at 10 Hz (Alpha range) over a light ambient bed. Designed to promote relaxed alertness and gentle focus. Best experienced with headphones.

tracks.title: Theta Waves (6 Hz)
tracks.description: Binaural beat at 6 Hz (Theta range) layered over a soft drone. Associated with deep meditation, REM sleep, and creative insight.

tracks.title: Delta Waves (2 Hz)
tracks.description: Deep delta wave binaural beat at 2 Hz for deep sleep and restoration. Subtle and unobtrusive — ideal for nighttime listening.

tracks.title: Focus Flow (14 Hz)
tracks.description: Low Beta binaural beat at 14 Hz to support concentration and mental clarity. A gentle rhythmic pulse under a calm ambient surface.

tracks.title: Soft Static
tracks.description: Pure, filtered white noise with a gentle high-frequency roll-off. Masks distracting sounds and creates a consistent auditory environment.

tracks.title: Pink Serenity
tracks.description: Pink noise — deeper and warmer than white noise, similar to steady rainfall. Often recommended for improving sleep quality and memory consolidation.

tracks.title: Lullaby in G Major
tracks.description: A gentle piano lullaby in G major. Simple, melodic phrases with soft dynamics and plenty of space between notes. Played with a warm, felted piano tone.

tracks.title: Acoustic Morning
tracks.description: Fingerstyle acoustic guitar played slowly and deliberately. Warm, resonant tones with a simple, repeating melody that invites a peaceful morning.

tracks.title: Harmonic Drift
tracks.description: A solo cello playing long, sustained notes that slowly shift in harmony. Rich overtones and a deep, soulful resonance.

tracks.title: Flute in the Valley
tracks.description: A simple wooden flute melody echoing across an imaginary valley. Earthy, authentic, and deeply grounding — inspired by Native American flute traditions.

nature.label: Nature Sounds
nature.description: Recordings from the natural world — rain, ocean, forests, and wildlife

ambient.label: Ambient Music
ambient.description: Synthetic and atmospheric textures for deep relaxation

white_noise.label: Noise & Static
white_noise.description: Consistent noise profiles for masking and focus

instrumental.label: Instrumental Music
instrumental.description: Live acoustic instruments — piano, guitar, cello, flute
